confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Norte area chief to confirm whether LH-02 is stopped (radio) or operating (CMMS). Nothing moved there until confirmed.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at N600-09 (11.9 g/t, 239 t broken). The likely repair is 13:30. Lending LH-08 from the DS-C538-01 development heading is the best option: it gains 27.7 oz and loses 0.8 oz at home, for a net of 26.9 oz. Norte stockpile has 208 t of room, so the extra ore fits. LH-02 has a radio/CMMS conflict, so I move nothing for that place (CONFIRM-01) and no loader is borrowed from it.
